rows.quote: The IMSGC dataset served as the discovery cohort, while the FinnGen R10 cohort was used for validation.

rows.quote: Our MR analyses utilized publicly available datasets, including the International Multiple Sclerosis Genetics Consortium (IMSGC) (Patsopoulos et al. 2019), the FinnGen study (Kurki et al. 2023), and other genome‐wide association studies (GWASs) (Table S1).
